intro: Chile is the world's biggest copper producer and one of Latin America's richest economies.

chapters.title: Copper and lithium
text: Chile produces about a quarter of the world's copper, from mines like Escondida. It is also a top lithium producer for batteries.

chapters.title: Fruit and fish
text: Chile exports salmon, cherries, grapes and wine.

keyTerms.meaning: A light metal used in batteries.
